name: ExLlamaV2: Fast inference library for local LLMs (GitHub: turboderp-org/exllamav2)
notes: ExLlamaV2 GitHub repository. Archived, development moved to ExLlamaV3. Contains performance benchmarks for GPTQ and EXL2 quantized models on 3090 Ti and 4090 GPUs. Supports paged attention via Flash Attention 2.5.7+. Dynamic generator with batching, prompt caching, and KV cache deduplication.
